item.title: Version 1.0.3
item.description:
What's New in Buzzy 1.0.3

  • Simplified Timer Controls: Streamlined break actions with a single, clear "Skip" button to end the break and return to idle.
  • Compact Button Labels: Shortened "Cancel session" to "Cancel" for a cleaner, modern interface.
  • Tidier Relaxation View: Removed redundant skip buttons from the relaxation card to focus purely on break activity tips.
  • Notification Icon Improvements: Ensured system notifications reliably display the cute Buzzy bee icon.
  • Updater & Stability Enhancements: Optimized background auto-updates and system compatibility.
